page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance built on x86_64 architecture using Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 physical cores configured as 32 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading active at two threads per core. System memory totals 128.0 GB RAM, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. Cache infrastructure consists of 32 KB L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. Hardware extension support includes AVX, AVX-512 foundation, AVX-512 VNNI, AES cryptography, and FMA instructions. The server runs under a KVM hypervisor with 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, featuring no integrated local disk storage or GPU hardware accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations reveal distinct performance trade-offs between parallel and single-threaded execution. Multi-core processor throughput falls into the middle tier, evidenced by a multi-core stress-ng score of 23,637.07, a Geekbench multi-core score of 8,902.0, and a PassMark CPU rating of 23,223.67. Memory subsystem performance remains moderate, posting 96.24 GB/sec for uncached large block reads and 48.07 GB/sec for large block writes. Conversely, single-core metrics reflect legacy hardware bottlenecks, with single-threaded stress-ng scoring 1,107.99 and Geekbench single-core reaching 995.0, ranking in the lower performance quartile.

The ecs.g5.8xlarge provides standard resource density suited for multi-threaded server environments where local disk availability is not mandatory. With 10 Gbps networking, it maintains solid performance for network-attached storage setups, reaching 17.15 GB/sec static web serving throughput and 22.63 million operations per second in Redis SET tests. While providing effective resource scaling for parallel tasks, container management, and software compilation, the instance is less cost-effective for single-threaded workloads demanding high per-core clock performance.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.8xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at 2.5 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization, it provides 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores, 128.0 GB RAM, and 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, without bundled local storage or GPUs. Hardware instructions include AVX-512 and AVX-512 VNNI. In performance benchmarks, the instance demonstrates solid average multi-core CPU and memory throughput, achieving a multi-core stress-ng score of 23,637.07 and 96.24 GB/sec uncached memory read bandwidth. However, single-core scores remain weak, with a Geekbench single-core score of 995.0. Maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is suitable for web serving, database systems backed by network storage, Redis caching, and software build pipelines.
